Maya: Quick non-work question 1 what's everyone's go-to comfort food after a rough deploy? Need inspo for tonight.
Jordan: Ramen, always. Add an egg and chili oil. :ramen: 
Sam: Grilled cheese + tomato soup. Melted cheddar, crust crisped. :bread:
Alex: Curry (coconut milk). Leftovers are better next day. :curry: 
Maya: Short poll: poll-bot: 'Comfort food pick' 1) Pizza 2) Ramen 3) Curry 4) Dessert. React to vote.
Jordan: :two: 
Sam: :one: 
Alex: :three: 
Maya: :four: (ice cream wins if all else fails)
Maya: Thanks y'all, trying ramen tonight and will report back with a pic. :camera_with_flash:
